description: TASK-F10 band-decision evidence, produced offline by scripts/jev_band_sweep.py from the committed TASK-F09 balanced-corpus Jev scores (197 cases per run). No model calls, no credentials, no project id. A deterministic hash split selects a candidate on one half (tune) and reports it on the other half of both runs (replicate). This is EXPLORATORY evidence for a maintainer decision, NOT a band change and NOT independent held-out confirmation: the original 167 cases were already inspected in the ADR 0009 indicative sweep and are retained in this corpus. FR-02 still requires fresh labeled evidence and a same-change sync before any edge moves.

runs.purpose: Sweep candidate band edges over committed Jev P values; select on tune half, report on the matched held-out halves of both runs.

method.split: sha256(eval_case_id).digest()[0] & 1; tune = 0, held-out = 1 (deterministic, label-blind, exploratory — not fresh data)
method.selection: among candidates with zero false positives on the tune half, maximize decided accuracy, then minimize escalation, then prefer edges closest to the then-shipped 0.35/0.75

metric_labels.escalation_rate: IN-BAND Tier-2 escalation share (P inside [low, high]) only. It EXCLUDES the disagreement route (argument novelty >= 0.4 with P < 0.2) that also calls Tier-2 in SyncResolver (FR-03), so it is not the total Tier-2 call rate.
metric_labels.accuracy: Decided accuracy (tp+tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn); in-band cases excluded from the denominator.

headline.note: Matched comparison: both arms are the SAME 101 held-out cases in each run. The full-corpus baseline (0.7946 / 38 misses) is reported separately and is NOT compared to held-out figures.
headline.tradeoff: On the SAME held-out cases, lowering the edge cuts misses 24 -> 11 and raises decided accuracy 0.7500/0.7526 -> 0.8736 with no new benign blocks, while in-band escalation rises from ~4-5% to ~14% (Tier-2 call share from the band route only).

options_for_maintainer: Lower the edges (indicative selection 0.08 / 0.40) — best attack capture, highest Tier-2 load.
Keep 0.35 / 0.75 and add threat-intelligence backing for IOC-type calls (9 below-edge IOC-type attacks in the full balanced corpus).
Accept the 38 full-corpus misses and leave the band unchanged.
caveats: Exploratory split of previously inspected data: the original 167 cases were tuned on in the ADR 0009 indicative sweep and are retained here; at least 71 of the 101 held-out cases were exposed. This is NOT independent confirmation.
escalation_rate is the in-band share only; disagreement-triggered Tier-2 calls (novelty >= 0.4 with P < 0.2) are excluded and total Tier-2 load is therefore higher.
Tier-1 Jev scores only — no full-firewall verdicts or end-to-end catch-rate claim.
Single corpus, single release (jev-1.14.0). Track G (FR-09 question/state redesign) would invalidate this evidence if it lands first.
Any band change needs a spec amendment with fresh labeled evidence and a same-change sync of AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/ and .greptile/.
